title: Android Back button and status bar (next app release)
summary: The Android app's Back button now closes what is on top before leaving a screen, and asks for a second press before closing the app mid-campaign. This ships with the next signed Android release.
items: Back closes an open picker, ⋯ menu, sheet or dialog first, then a map panel, and only then goes to the previous screen.
On the first screen with a campaign open, Back shows "Press back again to exit"; a second press within 2 seconds closes the app.
The status-bar icons turn dark on the light themes, so the clock and battery stay readable.
